phoneInbox.text: Found a wallet in the players' lot with 800 bucks in it. No ID. What do I do with it?

choices.label: Hand it to security
choices.reply: Security, mate. Someone's having a bad day

choices.label: Finders keepers
choices.reply: That's the hockey gods paying you. Keep it

phoneInbox.text: The national team sent over your gear list and spelled your name wrong on the nameplate. Want me to call them, or keep it for the trophy case?

choices.label: Keep it, it's funny
choices.reply: Keep it. That's going on the wall

choices.label: Get it fixed
choices.reply: Call them please. My grandma will be watching

phoneInbox.text: Your mother says the contract stuff has you stressed. Want to go fishing Sunday and not talk about it once?

choices.label: Sunday, no contract talk
choices.reply: Sunday. Not one word about money

choices.label: Can't, need the ice
choices.reply: Can't this week dad, I need the ice time

phoneInbox.text: I'm getting married in July and you're in the wedding. Do not tell me you have a skate.

choices.label: I'll be there
choices.reply: Front row, suit pressed, no skates. Congrats cuz

choices.label: Reception only
choices.reply: I can make the reception, I'm sorry about the ceremony

phoneInbox.text: That playoff beard is a whole personality at this point. Shave it live on stream for the children's charity?

choices.label: Shave it for charity
choices.reply: Chair. Tomorrow. Do your worst, it's for a good cause

choices.label: Keep the beard
choices.reply: Sorry, this thing is staying until we're eliminated or we win it all

phoneInbox.text: Haven't heard from you since the road trip started sweetheart. Everything okay out there? Call me when you get a second.

choices.label: Call her from the bus
choices.reply: Calling you right after the morning skate, promise. Love you
